limitations: All historical failed and unstable samples are retained. A-D are not substituted for the stricter final current-mode comparison.
Earlier positive results against an older MTP implementation did not establish superiority over the corrected MTP implementation; E failed that comparison.
Execution holds control automatic idle/display requests and are restored. No historical sleep cause is established; clock, thermal and external scheduling effects remain possible.
No consistent HighQoS benefit was found; priority and QoS defaults remain unchanged.
Power monitoring samples every five seconds, so transitions between samples may be missed.
Fresh-process trials are not cold-SSD proof, and no physical memory/SSD bandwidth is inferred.
CPU8 / cache 32 GiB / reserve 12 GiB / GDN111, target weights/routing/quantization, FP16 boundaries and seeded target sampling remain as configured.
Context 2048 and tested text sessions do not qualify every long context, image, GPU or NPU path.
40 and 50 tok/s remain objectives until matched measurements demonstrate them.
